reason: The base V7 preregistration incorrectly substituted gpt-5.6-luna even though the user's explicit frozen instruction required gpt-5.6-terra exclusively through OPENAI_API_KEY_2. This amendment corrects that implementation error rather than making a post-outcome model choice.

exclude: every segmentation, taxonomy, decoy, text-gate, or simulator artifact generated by gpt-5.6-luna
every downstream artifact derived from an excluded gpt-5.6-luna artifact
the existing FineWeb manual-audit sheets, because their rows were generated by gpt-5.6-luna
the existing tau2-bench Retail trajectories, activations, and AV reads, because the trajectories used a gpt-5.6-luna user simulator
retain: the immutable base preregistration as historical provenance
FineWeb source documents, raw target activations, and AV explanations generated without an OpenAI text model
public-environment trajectories, raw target activations, and AV explanations whose causal trajectory did not use gpt-5.6-luna
the directional reconstruction-metric amendment and its non-outcome GPU smoke
task selections and environment artifacts created before any text-model call

resume_rule: All new text-model artifacts must record this amendment SHA-256, requested_model gpt-5.6-terra, and a resolved model identifier beginning gpt-5.6-terra. Use fresh Terra-specific output roots; never overwrite or promote the archived Luna artifacts.
